1.title: Audience with the Princess
1.text: Zelda requests a private audience, which is how she asks for everything. She waits in the rose-covered garden pavilion with her hood lowered and steady green eyes fixed on you. "I have studied your house for months—its books, its customs, its people—yet I failed to account for one variable," she smiles faintly. "You. I would like to kiss you, Sam. Formally first, and then not formally at all."

image.comp: seated upright in a garden pavilion with hood lowered, hands in lap, composed with a warm smile, long elf ears
image.setting: garden pavilion at dusk, climbing roses, lantern light

1.goRes: The formal kiss is poised and sweet; the second parts your lips and leaves a flushed, breathless princess whispering, "Fascinating."
1.waitRes: "Of course." Zelda inclines her head regally. "Take whatever time you need—I have plenty to read in the meantime."

2.title: Without the Crown
2.text: You find Zelda on the rooftop at dusk with her hood thrown back, evening wind tangling her golden hair above the glowing town lanterns. "At home everyone bows and treats me like glass—you never bow, and it's a relief," she murmurs, guiding your warm hands onto her bare waist beneath her cloak. "Touch me as a woman, not a crown."

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop with hood back, wind in her long hair, looking at him with open warm eyes
image.setting: rooftop at dusk, view over town lights

2.goRes: Beneath the shelter of her cloak on the warm roof tiles, her royal poise melts into soft, breathless gasps as your hands explore her skin and her fingers work at your belt.
2.waitRes: "I understand." Zelda tilts her head with a gentle smile. "I will keep the roof warm for another evening."

3.title: A Kingdom of Two
3.text: Zelda sets aside her tome of sage lore and takes both of your hands, standing in a sheer white nightgown with her golden hair spilling loose past her waist. "Every decision of my life was made for duty—this one is solely mine," she whispers, letting the straps slide off her bare shoulders. "Stay in my bed tonight and show me what it means to be only Zelda."

image.comp: standing in a simple nightgown with long hair down, holding his hands, gentle nervous smile
image.setting: her guest suite, tall window, moonlight, books on a table

3.goRes: You peel off her nightgown and ease slowly into her tight, scorching heat, Zelda clinging to your shoulders with breathless, unguarded cries until dawn.
3.waitRes: "I am," she smiles softly. "Though I admire your care—ask again whenever you are ready; I am in no hurry."

jump.title: Royal Impulse
jump.text: Zelda is mid-lecture on bar-tab economics in the quiet library nook when she stops dead, flushes crimson, and lets her heavy tome thud onto the floorboards. "I have been composed for a hundred and twenty-eight years, Sam, and it has grown utterly tiresome," she breathes, grabbing your collar and kissing you hungrily.

image.comp: kissing him with a dropped book at her feet, startled at herself, poise cracking into a smile
image.setting: library nook, tall shelves, a fallen book

jump.goRes: You press her back against the bookshelves, hiking up her skirts and sinking inside her while economics is completely forgotten.
jump.waitRes: "Yes—quite right." Retrieving her book with scarlet cheeks, she murmurs, "I shall resume composure momentarily."

1.title: Imp No More
1.text: Midna perches on the edge of the bar counter like it's her personal throne, crimson hair cascading down her back and a wicked smirk curving her lips. "I was trapped as a tiny imp far too long—yet you never ignored me even then," she purrs, hooking her fingers into your hoodie strings and tugging you between her knees. "I'm going to kiss you now; do try to look honored."

image.comp: perched on the edge of a bar counter, long crimson hair, wicked amused smile, tugging his hoodie strings
image.setting: bar after hours, shimmering twilight light, empty stools

1.goRes: She laughs against your mouth before claiming your lips with fierce, possessive heat, pulling back with glowing eyes. "Adorable—now again."
1.waitRes: Midna arches a brow. "Making the Twilight Princess wait? Bold—I'll pretend to be offended until tomorrow."

2.title: Show Me Off
2.text: Midna hauls you onto the crowded lounge floor, announcing proudly to the room, "This one belongs to me tonight." Winding an arm around your waist while sliding her other hand boldly down over your rear, she smirks at the staring regulars. "Let them watch—tell me you enjoy it too."

image.comp: leaning against him with an arm around his waist, delighted smirk, glancing at unseen onlookers
image.setting: lounge floor, twilight lanterns, curious regulars watching

2.goRes: "I enjoy it," you tell her, and she laughs brightly before pulling you into a shadowed booth to slip her hands straight inside your trousers.
2.waitRes: "Spoilsport," she winks. "Fine—somewhere private, though I won't forget your hesitation."

3.title: Throne Room, Private
3.text: Midna's room is draped in shadow-silk and lit by a crown-shaped candle as she lounges naked across heaped cushions, one leg crossed lazily over the other. "I ruled an entire realm, Sam, yet I rarely get to be chosen," she whispers, her wicked smirk softening into raw desire. "Choose me tonight—not as a queen, just as yours."

image.comp: reclining on cushions like a throne, one leg crossed, wicked smile fading into genuine vulnerability
image.setting: her private room, shadow curtain, a crown-shaped candle

3.goRes: You climb onto the cushions and sink deep inside her, Midna arching beneath you with breathless, unguarded cries as the twilight outside glows brighter.
3.waitRes: "Of course I am," Midna purrs—before adding softly, "I like that you asked. I'll be waiting."

jump.title: Impulse Control
jump.text: Midna is mid-tease about a smudge on your hoodie when she stops, narrows her glowing eyes, and mutters, "Oh, forget the grand seduction plan." Grabbing your collar, she slams you back against the hallway wall and kisses you hungrily while grinding her hips against yours.

image.comp: grabbing his collar with a smug flushed grin, red hair tumbling, eyes bright
image.setting: upstairs hallway, a window showing twilight, lantern glow

jump.goRes: You kiss her breathless and haul her straight into your bedroom, kicking the door shut as she tears at your clothes.
jump.waitRes: "What? You're entirely too kissable." She smirks unrepentantly. "Fine—I'll draft a proper plan; be afraid."

1.title: Fresh Cream
1.text: Malon tops off a glass at the bar and slides it across to you while humming a ranch tune, her red braid resting over one shoulder. "Fresh from my family's herd—best in Hyrule," she smiles, biting her lip with rosy cheeks. "Truth is, I came to deliver milk and stayed because of you—and it keeps coming out sounding like dairy."

image.comp: leaning over a bar counter with a glass, cheeky bashful smile, red braid over one shoulder
image.setting: the house bar, wooden counter, glass jars of cream, afternoon light

1.goRes: She leans over the bar and kisses you warmly, tasting of sweet cream and strawberries. "There," she laughs breathlessly, "that came out much clearer."
1.waitRes: "Sure thing!" Malon grins, topping off your glass. "I'm not going anywhere—and ranch girls are great at waiting."

2.title: Lullaby
2.text: Malon hums a soft ranch lullaby while wiping down the bar after closing, watching you lean drowsily on the counter. Coming around the wood with a warm, teasing smile, she takes your hand and guides it onto her waist. "Works on restless foals and tired owners alike—let me use my hands on you."

image.comp: taking his hand with a sweet teasing smile, red braid swaying, humming softly
image.setting: bar after closing, lamplight, wiping cloth in hand

2.goRes: Her lullaby breaks off into soft, breathless gasps behind the bar as her warm, eager hands and mouth work you until dawn.
2.waitRes: "All right!" Malon pats your hand cheerfully. "A good song's always worth waiting for."

3.title: Barn Dance
3.text: The lantern-lit courtyard supper turns into a lively dance, Malon spinning you around the hay bales until you're dizzy and laughing. As the fiddle fades, she keeps hold of your hands with flushed cheeks and bright eyes. "I'm done being shy, Sam—stay in my bed tonight."

image.comp: holding both his hands after a dance, hair coming loose, sweet bright flushed smile
image.setting: courtyard with strung lanterns, hay bales, dusk

3.goRes: She leads you upstairs still humming softly, stripping off her ranch dress and straddling your hips—riding you with warm, breathless abandon all night long.
3.waitRes: "Mm-hm," Malon smiles warmly. "I love that you check, though—take a week if you need; I've got plenty of songs."

jump.title: Sudden Song
jump.text: Malon is stacking mugs in the back room when she bursts into joyful song mid-sentence, claps a hand over her mouth, and turns bright red. "Sorry—I always sing when I'm happy, and you make me ridiculously happy!" Hopping up to kiss your cheek, then your mouth, she giggles breathlessly. "I regret nothing!"

image.comp: hopping up to kiss him with a stack of mugs behind her, giggling, flushed, red braid bouncing
image.setting: bar back room, mugs and bottles, warm light

jump.goRes: You kiss her deeply, lifting her onto the back-room counter while she hums breathlessly against your lips and tugs at your belt.
jump.waitRes: "I know!" Malon laughs, cheeks scarlet. "Ranch girl—we act first." She scoops up the mugs, humming happily.

1.title: Healing Fountain
1.text: Cotera drifts gracefully through the curling bathhouse steam, translucent and sparkling with pink hair floating around her bare shoulders. "I have granted travelers' wishes for six centuries, yet nobody ever wished for me," she giggles, hovering inches before you. "Make a wish, little one—anything your heart desires."

image.comp: floating just above the bath edge with sparkling mist around her, teasing smile, long hair drifting
image.setting: bathhouse, rising steam, glowing water, mist

1.goRes: Her kiss tastes of spring rain and cherry blossoms, sparkling magic tingling across your lips. "Granted!" she laughs brightly. "Care for another wish?"
1.waitRes: Cotera pouts playfully before giggling. "A patient mortal! The fountain is always open whenever you're ready."

2.title: Wishes Come True
2.text: Cotera is unusually quiet for a Great Fairy who normally fills the bathhouse with laughter, sitting on the glowing stone rim with bare feet dangling in the warm water. "I always grant wishes and never ask for my own—do you know how lonely that feels?" she whispers softly. "Tonight, I want your hands on me."

image.comp: sitting on the stone rim with bare feet in the water, soft vulnerable smile, shimmering skin
image.setting: bathhouse alcove, glowing water, soft fairy lights

2.goRes: You step into the glowing water between her knees, running your hands over her shimmering, slick curves while she gasps and trembles against your mouth.
2.waitRes: "Oh." Cotera blinks, then sparkles warmly anyway. "A fairy can wait—just don't make it several decades."

3.title: Moonlit Fountain
3.text: Under the full moon, Cotera makes the entire bathhouse pool shimmer like liquid silver, drifting naked toward you through the steam. Pressing your palm flat against her warm, humming chest, she whispers, "I am born of ancient magic, yet tonight I feel purely like a woman. Stay with me in the water, little one."

image.comp: floating close with his hand pressed to her chest, silver moonlight, soft smile
image.setting: bathhouse at night, moonlight on glowing water

3.goRes: You sink deep inside her in the warm, glowing fountain—the water shining blindingly bright through every climax until dawn has the whole house whispering.
3.waitRes: "Terribly sure," Cotera laughs softly. "Still, I admire your care—a fairy can wait a little longer."

jump.title: Overflow
jump.text: Cotera is mid-laugh at a regular's story when she spots you across the bathhouse—sending ripples surging across the pool as she floats straight into your arms. "Subtlety isn't in a Great Fairy's nature!" she giggles, kissing you breathless. "I've wanted you for a month."

image.comp: kissing him mid-laughter, delighted, floating just above the tiles with sparkles drifting
image.setting: bathhouse, echoing tile hall, steam and sparkles

jump.goRes: You kiss her deeply as the warm fountain water sloshes over the stone rim, pulling her down into the steaming pool.
jump.waitRes: "Too sudden? Oh dear!" Covering her mouth with a laugh, she sparkles. "I'll rewind and try again—slightly subtler."

1.title: Spoils
1.text: Nabooru tosses a small velvet pouch into your lap—revealing a gleaming silver ring inside. "Lifted it off a bandit who deserved worse. Not a proposal—a trophy," she grins, leaning against the doorframe with arms crossed and a flicker of nerves beneath her Gerudo swagger. "I owe you a kiss for every decent thing you've done here, and I'm starting now."

image.comp: leaning in a doorway with arms folded, confident grin, braided red hair, a flicker of nerves
image.setting: the security post by the front door, a lantern, a stack of crates

1.goRes: She kisses you quick and fierce, then lingers for a second, slower taste. "One," she purrs with a wicked smile. "Keep count."
1.waitRes: Nabooru lifts her chin. "Later works—I've outlasted desert sandstorms, so I can certainly outlast a nervous man."

2.title: Night Watch
2.text: Standing night watch together on the starlit roof, Nabooru bumps her shoulder against yours with a low laugh. "Most men get intimidated when I stand this close—you just turn pink, and I love it," she murmurs, sliding one hand behind your neck and the other straight onto your belt. "Let's see where this goes."

image.comp: sitting shoulder to shoulder on a rooftop, her hand at the back of his neck, confident warm smirk
image.setting: rooftop at night, stars, quiet city

2.goRes: Watch duty is completely abandoned on the roof as her strong, practiced hands unfasten your trousers and work you breathless beneath the stars.
2.waitRes: "Fine." Nabooru's smirk holds steady. "I'll keep my hands to myself—probably."

3.title: Desert Heat
3.text: Nabooru's bedroom is stark as a warrior's tent—a spear mounted on the wall, a single lamp, and her athletic bronze body bare beneath an open silk wrap on the bed edge. "I have never needed anyone in my life, Sam, and I'm changing my mind tonight," she says steadily. "Stay with me."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a plain bed with arms resting on her knees, steady honest gaze
image.setting: her spare room, a spear on the wall, a single lamp, bedroll

3.goRes: Fierce and demanding at first before melting into breathless, clinging intensity beneath you, she admits quietly afterward that you're the finest haul of her life.
3.waitRes: "I wouldn't have asked if I wasn't," Nabooru smirks. "Take the night to think—I'm not going anywhere."

jump.title: Quick Hands
jump.text: Nabooru has already pickpocketed your quill, ledger notes, and coin purse before you even blink. "Just testing your reflexes," she grins—tucking the purse back into your pocket while grabbing your collar and kissing you breathless. "And you didn't see that coming either."

image.comp: tucking a wallet back into his pocket while kissing him, grinning, quick-handed, red braid swinging
image.setting: security desk, scattered quills and papers, lantern light

jump.goRes: You kiss her back hungrily, backing her onto the security desk and hiking up her Gerudo silks while she laughs breathlessly against your mouth.
jump.waitRes: "Fine, fine." She hands back your quill without a shred of remorse. "Though I refuse to apologize for the kiss."
